description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee chain with a location in the Pandosy Village neighbourhood of Kelowna, a walkable retail district near Okanagan Lake. The café offers handcrafted espresso drinks, whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a food menu spanning breakfast items, sandwiches, wraps, and baked goods. As a locally franchised outpost of a long-running BC chain, it represents a familiar rest stop for cyclists moving through the south Kelowna corridor.
